title: Econdb: maritime project delivery and customer installation

task.name: Deliver a complete maritime data project and maintained customer workspace
task.purpose: Turn the customer's selected maritime sources, analysis requirements and original commercial Workshare into a reproducible project, complete reports and an independently received customer installation.
task.request: Receive the complete original Workshare, commissioning source, phases, effort, payment stages and customer requirement. Select the original Econdb operator workspace and a saved project record. Preserve every current and selected prior response, descriptor, request parameter and source edition. Use the original maritime project engines for locally selected date windows, period comparisons and source revision analysis. Export the entire operator workspace through its original transfer operation, and retain its complete project and analysis files. Prepare the customer Installation from that inspected source and the actual Workshare seed, keeping source-use authority, merchant and buyer identities, receiving host and payment selections explicit. Save through the existing Customer installations writer. Deliver the full native case together with the complete Econdb sidecar, independently receive both, and operate the reopened project and reports.
task.completeOutput: The complete Econdb workspace ZIP and original operator-transfer.json; original workspace requests, results and history; selected project configuration, input binding, manifest, complete project-analysis.json, exact observations CSV, HTML report, editable browser workspace and reopening guide; every current/prior source response and descriptor; retained producing source modules; complete customer source report and selection descriptor; original commissioning source, Workshare seed, technical profile and bindings; complete Installation input, preview/workorder, commercial JSON/Markdown/HTML, extra selected attachments, and independently received native customer case with its mandatory Econdb sidecar.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual source revision, requested port or measure, changed date selection, reporting period or customer requirement produces a reviewed new original project edition. Continue interrupted commands with their saved request identities. Update customer commissioning through the current Installation and preserve prior reports, source history and independent edits.
task.pricedUnit: The original commercial Workshare defines implementation fees, phase effort, delivery schedule, payment stages and support. Any separately priced resource task uses the recorded merchant offer, selected network/asset/recipient, exact atomic price and buyer-approved task budget. A maritime source cell, project entry, report edition and paid task retain their original distinct meanings.

source.population: The entire original exported Econdb operator workspace, its complete request/result history and file inventory, plus one explicitly selected saved maritime project record and every project member. The selected project includes all current and selected prior responses, descriptors, observations, source modules and analysis outputs.
source.meaning: Each project entry keeps its source role, observed capture time, request endpoint/query, port, measure, population, frequency and half-open local date selection. Preserve exact decimal strings and source lexemes in the original analysis and JSON. Known, null, absent and unsupported values remain distinct. Unassigned ports, undeclared frequency, partial months, missing monthly labels and incomplete comparison series remain visible. Entry-level cell counts can include repeated views of a source; capacity and volume across measures or populations have no combined numerical total.
source.changePolicy: The exported workspace and chosen project are a frozen source edition. Retain its original transfer manifest, project manifest, input digest and project record revision. Later captures and analyses use the original operator's command journal and produce their own saved editions. Customer changes use the current Installation, retaining accepted checks, assignments and independent edits. Source licensing, retention and withdrawal follow the actual source owner's authority.

receiving.application: The maintained Econdb operator and maritime project viewer, original whole-workspace transfer receiver, and SF47 Customer installations, Customer commissioning and Workshare desks.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Open the complete original project report, observations, analysis and current/prior source files. Check the requested port, measure, population, query parameters and date windows against the source. View unknown cells and incomplete coverage in their original reports. Independently receive the full operator workspace, verify and reopen the selected project, and reopen its browser workspace. Preview/save the Installation using the original case writer, then export/import its complete native case together with the full Econdb sidecar. Operate the actual desktop and narrow application and open/use every outgoing attachment.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer owns the requested analysis and permitted source population. The source owner controls licensing and permitted reuse; the data operator maintains source acquisition and project editions; the merchant owns its offer and commercial scope; the independent buyer controls signing and spending. Named reviewers approve interpretation and acceptance in the original customer case.
receiving.recovery: Resume the existing preparation directory with the same saved request and exact original input bytes. Receive the preserved full workspace through the original Econdb transfer receiver in a separate directory; recover uncertain Econdb commands through their original journal. Use the same native Installation request, version and event after an uncertain save. Preserve prior case and source editions while reconciling current state.
receiving.maintenance: Name the customer reviewer, source owner, data engineer, merchant, buyer, receiving engineer and support owner. Retain source/license records, capture and refresh expectations, project configuration and producing engine source, credential environment references, backup/retention policy and support scope. Keep implementation fees, support obligations and grant/commercial allocations in the original Workshare and operating case.

steps.title: Receive the customer requirement and commercial source
steps.result: Select the complete original Workshare and commissioning source with every phase, effort estimate, payment stage, intended reporting course and named responsibility.

steps.title: Build the complete original maritime project
steps.result: Use the existing Econdb source and project engines with actual port, endpoint/query, measure, population and date selections. Preserve current and selected prior source editions and the full observed analysis.

steps.title: Inspect the full workspace and selected saved project
steps.result: Receive the original operator transfer, verify every selected project file, and bind the saved project record, request, input and manifest identities. Retain all workspace bytes and source history.

steps.title: Compose the customer installation
steps.result: Use the original Workshare seed, maintained profile and explicit source/recipient/payment/host bindings. Preserve the full original acceptance checks, funding assignments, phases and commercial terms.

steps.title: Save and deliver both complete applications
steps.result: Preview and save through the existing native Installation writer. Export its complete case and carry the original Econdb ZIP, transfer manifest, selected project files, commercial documents and extra attachments together.

steps.title: Independently receive and operate the delivery
steps.result: Import the complete case and Econdb workspace in separate receiving directories. Open the source responses, project report, complete analysis, exact observations and editable browser workspace. Operate and view the final desktop/narrow customer course.

steps.title: Continue source editions and agreed support
steps.result: Keep later source captures and project commands in the original Econdb workspace. Use the existing Installation for customer changes, preserve independent edits and apply the Workshare's actual support and payment terms.

inputs: Complete original commercial commissioning source and Workshare seed, pinned operating plan, every phase/effort estimate, implementation fee, payment stage and original OPEN acceptance check.
Complete exportOperator workspace directory transported in econdb-workspace.zip, with unchanged operator-transfer.json and all original workspace members.
Explicit saved project record ID/revision, original request SHA-256, project input SHA-256 and complete project manifest; original project-analysis.json and all project members.
Current and selected prior response/descriptor files, exact entry selections and comparison windows, original producing source modules, browser workspace and extra working attachments.
Actual customer source-use authority, existing merchant/buyer deployment identities, selected payment terms and approved task budget, named receiving host and operator.
Complete native Installation save identity or existing Installation selection, full case export, mandatory complete Econdb sidecar and independent application/output receiving records.
